summary: Tested new Payment History and Customer Statement features in Vendor Billing. Backend: 11 pytest cases covering POST/GET/DELETE payments and GET /statement all pass. Frontend: PayDialog opens via pay-status pill, add/list/fill-outstanding/log-payment flows work, parent invoice list refreshes (row shows 'Partly Paid', Paid ₹3,000, Due ₹8,800). Statement tab generates KPIs correctly (Opening ₹0, Billed ₹5,900, Collected ₹1,000, Closing ₹4,900), Invoices & Payments tables render, Print popup opens with 'STATEMENT OF ACCOUNT', R K ENTERPRISES header, customer name, and payment reference.
critical_code_review_comments: billing.py statement endpoint: opening_balance query uses inv_q['customer'] regex (case-insensitive) — good. However statement invoice filter uses date string comparison ('$gte'/'$lte'/'$lt') which relies on ISO YYYY-MM-DD stored consistently; there is no server-side validation of date format. Consider parsing/validating start/end and returning 400 on bad format.

add_payment does not validate payment amount > 0 or that amount <= (grand_total - paid). Overpayment is silently accepted and status still flips to 'Paid'. Consider server-side clamp/reject to prevent accidental double posts.

_recompute_invoice_payment status logic uses `total_paid >= gt - 0.5` (50-paise fuzz) — fine for INR rounding, but the same tolerance is duplicated in the older PATCH endpoint and PayDialog UI. Extract to a shared helper for consistency.
billing.py is now 867 lines — nearing 700-line guideline. Consider splitting rate-master, invoice, and payment/statement handlers into separate modules.
printStatement popup: no popup blocker handling in some browsers if window.open returns null (toast is shown, good). Consider degrading to same-window print via iframe.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: created 3 invoices for TEST CUSTOMER <hex>, TEST UI CUSTOMER, TEST STMT CUSTOMER and associated payments. All cleaned up after test runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment History (POST/GET/DELETE /api/billing/invoices/{id}/payments, DELETE /api/billing/payments/{pid}) and GET /api/billing/statement are green. The pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_billing_payments_statement.py must be run with '-n0' to disable xdist parallel workers (they run different classes on separate workers and race the delete-all cleanup vs list ordering). All 11 tests pass serially in ~5s. Frontend PayDialog and Statement tab flows work end-to-end incl. print popup.
rca of the issue: No functional issues found. Only a test-runner nuance: default pytest.ini enables xdist which caused one flaky ordering failure across worker boundaries; resolved by running with -n0. The tests themselves rely on ordered flow within a single class, which is fine when workers=0.
